description: Source code for the NetworkChangeNotifierPassive class, which handles network change events such as DNS changes, IP address changes, and connection type/subtype changes within the Chromium project.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierPassive
classes.description: Implements passive network change notifications, handling DNS, IP address, connection type, and bandwidth changes.

methods.name: NetworkChangeNotifierPassive
methods.description: Constructor initializing with connection type and subtype, optionally with a DNS config notifier.

methods.name: OnConnectionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in network connection type.

methods.name: OnConnectionSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in network connection subtype and updates bandwidth.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current network connection type.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves current max bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: NetworkChangeCalculatorParamsPassive
methods.description: Provides network change calculation parameters based on platform.
